subject: Post-demo: VecStack embedding retrofit — auth, routing & reranker proposal
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@vecstack.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 Aug 2025 14:12:00 -0400
Subject: Post-demo: VecStack embedding retrofit — quick recap and proposed next steps

Hi Alice — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and a proposal for the engineering PoC we discussed. I’ve split items by engineering and commercial so we have clear owners.

What we heard: VecStack is currently on VectorCloud (proprietary) with 768-d vectors and a custom similarity pipeline; you’re looking to:
- improve recall on long-tail queries,
- reduce per-query latency during peak (50k qps spikes), and
- move away from the opaque vendor lock-in to an open inference stack.

Proposal (PoC scope, 2–3 weeks):
1) Sample & eval: VecStack sends 5k representative queries + current doc vectors (or a 10% sample) — we’ll run a side-by-side recall@10, MRR and cost comparison (Redwood quantized models vs VectorCloud).
2) Embedding profile: test 1536-d (recommended), 1024-d, and 768-d to see quality/cost tradeoffs. We’ll provide scripts to downsample and normalize.
3) Integration: SDK setup + auth options (API key quickstart, OIDC service account for production). We recommend OIDC short-lived tokens for cross-team access control.
4) Routing: policy-based routing by region (us-east-1 primary, fallback eu-west-1) and by cost tier for reranker calls.
5) Reranker: stitch a lightweight neural reranker that accepts structured tool-calls from the search layer and returns top_k with scores and provenance fields (doc_id, chunk_idx, source).

Immediate asks from VecStack:
- sample queries file (attached format)
- existing embedding dimension and normalization method (L2 or none)
- any existing per-query latency P95 numbers and QPS patterns

I’ve attached a PoC sample CSV and a proposed auth flow diagram. Karthik — can you scope the infra checklist for the PoC (SDK snippet, required roles, and expected infra footprint)? Marissa — commercial follow-up for usage estimate and trial credits.

Next meeting: suggest Wed 8/13 10am ET for a technical kickoff.

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

From: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@vecstack.ai>

Cc: VecStack Engineering <eng@vecstack.ai>, tom.vendor@cloudops.example.com
Date: Mon, 11 Aug 2025 09:24:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo: VecStack embedding retrofit — quick recap and proposed next steps

Sean — thanks for the detail, this is helpful. A few clarifications from engineering: 

1) Current vectors are 768-d float32, no L2 normalization (we currently relied on the vendor’s internal dedupe).
2) Typical baseline QPS during business hours: 400 QPS; peak 35k QPS for index refresh windows (15–30 minutes).
3) P95 latency for our search path (vendor + local rerank) is ~220ms; we want to target P95 <160ms after migration.

Regarding PoC artifacts: sending a 5k query sample and a 10% document sample now (attached). For auth: we prefer long-term plan to be OIDC service accounts integrated with our IAM — API keys are ok for the PoC.

On reranker format: we need clear output fields. Proposed minimal output: top_k list with {doc_id, score, chunk_index, source, snippet}. Can your reranker include a confidence score and a per-candidate reason token (short string)?

We’re good for Wed 8/13 10am ET.

–Alice
Alice Moreno
Head of Search, VecStack
alice.moreno@vecstack.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Post-demo: VecStack embedding retrofit — infra checklist and SDK notes

Sean / Marissa — prepping the technical checklist for the kickoff. Notes below (high level) — I’ll have a runnable checklist Monday morning.

Auth / SDK: 
- PoC: API key using Redwood SDK (python/js) + env var; include example for Dockerized workers.
- Prod: recommend OIDC + short-lived tokens using our service-account flow; we’ll provide Terraform snippet for the IRSA role mapping (EKS) or equivalent for VM-based workloads.

Embedding profile & normalization: 
- We will test 1536-d (higher recall target) and 768-d for parity. Expect roughly 2x index storage for 1536-d; recommend L2 normalization at serve-time (we’ll provide a normalization batch job).
- If VecStack wants to keep existing vectors, we’ll run a compatibility pass: apply L2 norm to existing float32 vectors and run a sanity recall check; if quality drops, we’ll re-embed selected high-impact documents.

Batching & throughput: 
- Online: batching for embed calls up to batch_size 128 (depending on GPU memory), continuous batching in the runtime to keep latency under control.
- Offline reindex: use parallel workers with batch_size 512–2048 for faster throughput (cost vs time tradeoff).

Reranker integration & structured output: 
- Reranker API will accept search results + context and return a JSON array: {doc_id, chunk_index, score, confidence, provenance_url, reason_label}. The SDK will map that into the client’s expected schema.
- Tool-calling note: if VecStack needs structured tool calls (e.g., to request a snippet expansion), we’ll support a minimal function-calling contract: name, args, return_schema.

Fallbacks & routing: 
- Primary: Redwood us-east-1 cluster (quantized models).
- Fallback: eu-west-1 cluster (if regional outage) and a low-cost variant (smaller model) for non-critical traffic.

Data handling & compliance:
- For PoC we can accept anonymized sample data. For production, we’ll offer VPC peering or Private deployment options and KMS integration for envelope encryption.

I’ll attach a short SDK snippet and the Terraform role mapping in the checklist. For the PoC infra footprint, estimate: 1 g4dn.12xlarge equivalent for indexing and 2-3 g5 instances for online inference depending on qps.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference

Attachment: reranker-integration-snippet.md (text/markdown)
